versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update with new features, CI enhancements, and improved usability.

- Adds built-in CI tests and scripts (README.md, ci_check.py, verify_product.py).
- Introduces "self-test" command for easy verification.
- Refactors and clarifies CLI commands and options.
- Improves documentation: streamlined SKILL.md, adds usage and CI examples.
- Removes deprecated skill-card.md.

- Initial release of Markdown Linter & Fixer (v1.0.0)
- Provides a zero-dependency CLI tool to lint, validate, and auto-fix Markdown files using Python stdlib only
- Supports table of contents generation, broken link detection, YAML frontmatter validation, and formatting fixes
- Offers commands for linting, TOC insertion, link checking, frontmatter field validation, and formatting
- Designed for CI pipelines and docs-heavy repos without requiring Node.js or pip dependencies
